splitDecision.rationale: RemoteRole and future-run ICE can share the closeout report, but should remain logical subbatches because Future-run ICE requires stricter runpath and effectiveRunQuote context.

boardRunpathContextRules.rule: RemoteRole facts describe static card function; rezzed/active/same-server/fort context remains board state.
Future-run facts describe future run consequences only; current relevance needs ongoing run, remaining ICE, later encounter and unbroken subroutine context.
For concrete path costs, effectiveRunQuote remains authoritative over generated static run_tax/future_run facts.
Remote protection remains strategy/overlay context, not a generated mechanical fact in this closeout.
